entries.08ce096e6af65f34: Car and Motorcycle Goods Sales Business
entries.0dddc8a026760d00: 2rinkan Yellow Hat Co., Ltd. engages in retail sales of motorcycle accessories and related products at its '2rinkan' stores, Baiku-kan Yellow Hat Co., Ltd. engages in retail and wholesale sales of motorcycles and motorcycle accessories and related products at its 'Baiku-kan' stores, and Wise Road Yellow Hat Co., Ltd. engages in retail sales of motorcycles and motorcycle accessories and related products at its 'Wise Road' stores. The number of stores at the end of March 2026 was 65 for 2rinkan, 78 for Baiku-kan (including Kawasaki Plaza) and 28 for Wise Road. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, 'Motorcycle Accessories' in revenue by product category (consolidated total) was ¥13,987 million (8.2% of total).
entries.43ad3228b4ac7e4d: Sales Subsidiaries, Affiliates and Group Companies
entries.51472d76b6f12e2b: Sales subsidiaries, affiliated companies, group companies and others that operate "Yellow Hat" and "Kakuyasu Tire Tread" stores sell car products and other goods at retail.
entries.8e733cf60c770c4f: The company leases buildings and facilities to sales subsidiaries, affiliates and group companies. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥5,793 million (100.2% year on year, an increase of ¥13 million), and segment profit (based on operating profit in the consolidated statement of income) was ¥1,406 million (100.9% year on year, an increase of ¥12 million).
entries.9fefa828facfe7a7: A company that supplies car products and motorcycle products wholesale to sales subsidiaries and group companies, and sells them to general customers at stores such as "Yellow Hat".
